title: `style: GitHub` is rejected as an unknown style #147

Opened by scott · 2 comments
summary: The frontmatter style lookup is case sensitive. A canvas that declares `style: GitHub` gets an `unknown-style` diagnostic and renders with the default style. The message suggests `github`, so the parser already knows what the author meant. An editor that capitalizes the first word of a value triggers this on every save.

sections.title: Steps to reproduce
sections.body:
1. Write a canvas whose first three lines are `---`, `style: GitHub`, and `---`.
2. Run `bb canvas check` on the file.
3. Open the file beside the chat.

sections.title: Expected
sections.body: `bb canvas check` prints a success line that names `style github`, and the canvas renders with the GitHub look. Case should not matter for a value drawn from a fixed list of two names.

sections.title: Actual
sections.body: `bb canvas check` prints `unknown style GitHub; did you mean github?` and exits 1. The canvas opens with the default style and a problem card at line 1.

sections.title: Relevant code
sections.body:
<Source path="server/parse.ts">
```ts
seen.add(key);
if (isStyleName(value)) {
  style = value;
  continue;
}
const didYouMean = suggestStyleName(value);
problems.push({
  kind: "diagnostic",
  diagnostic: { code: "unknown-style", message: `unknown style ${value}`, span },
});
```
</Source>
